feedback: Approved to race. The candidate returns the controller to iteration 5 (kp 2.6, kd 0.9, ki 0.05, base_speed 1.2, last_direction), which is the best raced controller (699.16), and changes one geometry value: sensor x positions widen from ±0.03 m to ±0.04 m at y 0.06, with the 16 mm footprint and sensor_weights [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2] unchanged. Iteration 5 showed that the oval and s-bend finish 20/20 under this controller, so the score base is known. Slalom max_error sat between 0.0618 and 0.0646 under every controller tried (iterations 3 to 7), so controller changes have not cleared the 0.06 m limit. Iteration 1 showed that wider x coverage cut s-bend line losses from 2.05 to 1.15 and slalom losses from 1.75 to 1.05. That evidence is confounded, because iteration 1 also enlarged the footprint and changed the gains, so this race is the cleaner test. Because sensor_weights are fixed, the signal scale does not change, so the risk is mainly that the reading-weighted average shifts on the oval and s-bend. The decision to race now rests on that: this is the best controller, the change is a single geometry field, and three iterations remain for follow-up. After the race, read the results by track. If the oval or s-bend finish rate falls below 0.95, return x to ±0.03 m, which is the known-good layout. If the slalom still ends off track with max_error at or above 0.06 and line_loss_events stay at or above 1.0, the coverage lever has not solved the slalom, so the next step is a small kd change (0.9 to 1.0) with ki held at 0.05. If slalom line_loss_events fall below about 0.8 and any slalom run finishes, hold the geometry and controller fixed and confirm the score.
requested_changes: If the oval or s-bend finish rate drops below 0.95 (iteration 5 reference: both 20/20), return sensor x positions to ±0.03 m (-0.03, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.03) and keep kp 2.6, kd 0.9, ki 0.05, base_speed 1.2.

If slalom line_loss_events stay at or above 1.0 and max_error is still at or above 0.06 with x at ±0.04 m, test kd 1.0 with kp 2.6, ki 0.05 and base_speed 1.2, since iteration 5 (kd 0.9) gave 1.05 line losses and iteration 4 (kd 0.8) gave 1.0.
If any slalom run finishes with x at ±0.04 m, hold geometry and the controller fixed and use the next race to confirm the score rather than change gains.
